name: Valorant
notes: Yaw is fixed at 0.07. FOV is 103 horizontal at 16:9 (about 70.5 vertical) with the vertical angle kept for other aspect ratios; these FOV values come from community sources, not Riot documentation. Trainer geometry (the `trainer` block) is an assumption, not a measurement: head about 0.2 m wide seen from 6-30 m (0.4-1.9 degrees), duels mostly under 20 degrees, strafing at 3-6 m/s. Riot publishes no hitbox or speed numbers; measure them in the shooting range (docs/REVIEW.md, Realism) and set verified to true.

flash.notes: Documented windups (PC): Curveball 0.6 s, Blindside 0.6 s, Breach Flashpoint about 0.5 s, Guiding Light 0.3 s, FLASH/drive telegraph 0.3 s; maximum blind 1.5 s (Curveball, Blindside) to 2.25 s. Players who look away are blinded only briefly (secondary sources). The time a flash is visible before it pops also contains part of its flight, which no source gives: popDelaySeconds 0.45-0.9 is an assumption, chosen so that the simulated hand neither always nor never turns away in time. The exit margin of 10 degrees past the edge of the screen is an assumption for the glare. Measure both in the shooting range and set verified to true.
